subject: Tundra status: parser trained, action-item labels are the weak spot
body:
Hi Dmitri, Deshawn,

Status. The AP-parsing task trains end to end on our generated vocabulary and the annotation ratings. Problem-cluster segmentation is strong — 0.84 F1 on held-out notes. Action-item typing is much weaker at 0.61, and the confusion is concentrated in two label pairs that the annotation guide itself describes ambiguously.

Risk: this isn't a modeling gap we can train away. Two annotators disagree on those pairs about a quarter of the time, so our ceiling is roughly where we already are. Options are to merge the two ambiguous label pairs into single coarse labels, or to re-annotate a subset with a tightened guide. Merging is cheap and probably enough for the summarizer use case; re-annotation is weeks.

Yara
